rules.name: Return Window Validation
rules.description: Item must have been delivered within 30 days of the refund request date.
rules.exception: Applies unless item arrived damaged or defective with immediate report within 7 days.

rules.name: Non-Refundable Category Exclusion
rules.description: Certain categories such as gift cards, perishables, and clearance items are strictly non-refundable.

rules.name: Damaged or Defective Items
rules.description: Items arriving damaged or defective are eligible for full refund or replacement.

rules.name: High Value Refund Escalation
rules.description: Refund requests exceeding $500 require human customer support manager approval.

rules.name: High Risk Customer Return Rate Escalation
rules.description: Customers with return rate >= 40% or >= 3 previous refunds are flagged for fraud risk.
rules.reason: Customer account exhibits high return frequency or elevated risk score.

rules.name: Good Standing Fast-Track
rules.description: Loyal customers with low return rates (<10%) and amount <= $100 receive fast-track auto-approval.

rules.name: Opened Item Buyer Remorse
rules.description: Buyer remorse or unwanted items that have been opened and used cannot be refunded.
rules.reason: Opened and used items are not eligible for remorse-based returns.
